content.text:
The medium segment's net sales decline in September 2026 is explained by the absence of any new orders in that month for this segment, as there were zero orders recorded (Evidence: inv_4a0be1dad9ae4bf394109e3c34b1c8e1:E2). However, there was a refund of 800 cents ($8.00) processed in September 2026 for an order originally placed in August 2026 (order O8, refund RF4) (Evidence: inv_4a0be1dad9ae4bf394109e3c34b1c8e1:E3). 

This means the decline is due to no new sales revenue combined with refunds being processed in September for previous orders. Refund reasons are unknown from these records. The analysis covers the UTC date range from 2026-09-01 (inclusive) to 2026-10-01 (exclusive).

sql_attempts.purpose: Get orders and refunds details for the medium segment in September 2026 to understand the decline
sql_attempts.sql:
SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date, o.amount_cents AS order_amount_cents, r.refund_id, r.refund_date, r.amount_cents AS refund_amount_cents
FROM orders o
LEFT JOIN refunds r ON o.order_id = r.order_id
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE c.segment = 'medium' AND o.order_date >= '2026-09-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-10-01'
ORDER BY o.order_date, o.order_id, r.refund_date;
